stage: 3 — build the Track 1 route, shadow only

verdict.summary: The route exists, runs, and reproduces the measured Track 1 book event for event on all three windows. It cannot place an order: the gate refuses while any blocker is open, and three are. BLOCK-4 (per-sleeve quantity) is closed by this build; BLOCK-2 is answered structurally by the route having its own entry point.

positions.why_off: a replay's end state is a book as of a historical window; writing it to a live-looking path is how a misleading artifact gets created and then believed

lock.why: the shadow route takes no lock because it touches no broker

checkpoint.isolation: route-scoped keys, O_EXCL file lock, ScopeViolation on a merge that would touch another route

window_ledger.why_not: the ledger's contract is 'did an observation happen at all'; a replay knows only the days a trade existed, not the days the window was watched and produced nothing. Emitting window_closed from a replay would manufacture the evidence the ledger exists to withhold.

blockers_open.text: One IB Gateway login is one position book. IBKRBroker has no account dimension; get_positions() and get_equity() read the whole login. Two routes on one account net at the broker and both halt on the resulting mismatch.
blockers_open.closed_by: a dedicated account for Track 1, or retiring legacy first — which is the stated end state and the cheaper of the two

blockers_open.text: Calm A and Stress open before the day's own 13:45 pre-flight. The D-1 contract is encoded and tested, but the intraday source is unverified by any gate.
blockers_open.closed_by: a pre-10:00 freshness job, or an in-window bar-quality check that can fail closed

blockers_open.text: No sleeve has a promoted live signal generator. Normal-R4 alone runs through model_sameday_stop.run_loop, scratch/harness Cfg/patched_engine, a doubly-wrapped TrendFollowStrategy, force_all_bars_gappable and two scratch filter modules, with futures/_validated_core.backtest_swing_tf monkeypatched out of the way.
blockers_open.closed_by: promoting each generator with its own equivalence proof; the list is in global_index/track1_sleeves.LIVE_SOURCE_PREREQUISITES

blockers_resolved_by_this_build.how: quantity is a field on Candidate, not a lookup by instrument; MNQ=1 under Normal and MNQ=7 under Stress are both expressible, tested, and exercised on real measured rows
